recipe.cacheUnitSelectionRule: A candidate is any composed record whose target or entity list carries a canonical identity key of a question personId (normalized full name, email, or phone digits; manifest mention surfaces are not used, to avoid cross-person surname collisions). Candidates are ranked by the number of distinct question persons the record mentions (descending), then by target string (ascending), then by record id (ascending). Records are added greedily in that order only when they cover at least one question person not already covered, and only while the rendered prefill stays within 32768 minus 1024 reserved tokens. Selection stops when every question person is covered or the candidates are exhausted. Rejected records are counted as redundant (no new coverage) or budget dropped (new coverage but over budget); record text is never shortened.
recipe.cagHybridSelectionRule: Per question, candidates are the composed records whose target or entity list carries a canonical identity key of the question personId (normalized full name, email, or phone digits; the same key function the cache unit uses). A record whose own target carries a person key is a subject record for that person; subject records are ordered by target string then record id ascending. Only when a person has no subject record does selection fall back to the records that merely mention the person in their entity list, ordered by record id ascending. Records are added in that order only while the rendered prefill stays within 32768 minus 1024 reserved tokens; a record that does not fit is counted as a cap hit, and record text is never shortened. Each question gets its own prefill and DynamicCache; no KV state is reused across questions.
